Normal Eager path; TaskQueue enabled; no graph capture, lazy fusion or cache hit.
Default: one Repository per device; PER_STREAM_QUEUE: one per used internal stream.
First enqueue in INIT also waits for Host drain before switching to RUN.
Parameter release is not a hardware completion fence.
Per-stream queue or IPC: caller waits for record submission count to clear.
Runtime stream dependency; caller does not synchronize device completion here.
